limits: Three paired trained seeds, df=2; masks/examples/layers are repeated observations, not independent model replicates.
Exploratory checkpoint/data reuse; frozen router gate does not make the official test globally untouched.

H4 recomputes the fraction from saved per-example degree energies; full class logits are not in these downloaded compact arrays, so this check does not independently regenerate the transform from original logits.
Mechanism examples are a fixed128-position policy-fit prefix. Gradient comparisons are descriptive, not independent causal mechanism identification.
Fractional-logit errors use class-centered logits; comparison with corner CE differs from CE of interpolated logits.
Annealed final survival mixture is identically dense because rho=1; zero mean bias there is algebraic, not evidence of learned affine behavior.
The two finite-difference epsilon estimates disagree substantially, especially for Gaussian directions; precise local-Jacobian/anisotropy claims are not supported by this probe alone.

Final-checkpoint rank correlations deteriorate despite high SSE skill. Very small dense losses motivate a post hoc numerical-sensitivity description; no frozen outputs were changed or examples removed from the primary analysis.

Large all-example first-order SSE skill is not uniform fidelity: selected-checkpoint mean block scores on full-correct examples range roughly0.47–0.89, lower than all-example scores; a few full-model mistakes can dominate squared error.
The last-branch suffix is a linear head, yet its finite-difference estimates disagree across epsilon; this demonstrates a numerical component to the finite-difference instability.

posthoc_gradient_precision_description.status: Post hoc numerical sensitivity description; does not replace the frozen all-example endpoint
posthoc_gradient_precision_description.interpretation: Losses below unit-scale FP32 epsilon flag possible cancellation in p_true-1; these counts do not prove a numerical cause. Restricted rank correlations are diagnostic, not a new confirmatory endpoint.

comparison_with_main_analysis.note: Tiny CI endpoint differences reflect the main analysis rounding t critical to4.302653.

linear_head_finite_difference_self_check.reason: Branch3 state is followed only by the mandatory linear classifier (output_relu=false in this main cohort). Exact centered-logit directional derivative therefore cannot depend on epsilon; nonzero two-epsilon disagreement here is numerical, not a downstream ReLU crossing. This does not identify which specific floating-point backend operation dominates.
